name: Crazy Wood Works
old_description: At Crazy Wood Works LLC, we design and build one-of-a-kind wood pieces that elevate your home. From custom cabinets to handcrafted furniture and expert cabinet refacing, our work blends craftsmanship, durability, and timeless style—made right here in Oklahoma City.
about:
Crazy Wood Works LLC operates from Oklahoma City, Oklahoma, where it designs and builds custom wood pieces for residential clients. The company focuses on one-of-a-kind cabinets, handcrafted furniture, and cabinet refacing services, all produced locally.

The shop handles custom cabinet design and construction, handcrafted furniture manufacturing, and cabinet refacing as an alternative to full replacement. Services include hardware updates, partial refacing, and touch-ups, with clients selecting materials, finishes, and hardware to match their design vision. Each piece is made to order, with no standardized product lines.

The company serves homeowners and residential contractors in the Oklahoma City area seeking custom cabinetry, furniture, and refacing solutions. Typical projects include kitchen and bathroom cabinet installations, built-in furniture pieces, and cabinet facade updates for remodeling projects.

Crazy Wood Works emphasizes clear timelines, transparent pricing, and dependable service from start to finish. The business positions its locally made, craftsmanship-driven approach as a differentiator, offering personalized service for each project.
